title: My vehicle farming game coded using free access to Claude
author: ander_hominem
selftext:
So yeah, I'm broke and I don't use paid options, only free access. It's actually almost enough for me, with some time management often I don't need more of free use than it gives, and when I need I just ask it to continue generating every few hours. I was trying other AIs last year Autumn and they still were underwhelming, and even GPT was kinda meh and frustrating. But this year I decided to try using Claude and it's amassing, and I was comparing it to GPT, and GPT is kinda very lazy, it feels like it's trying to avoid working

I use Godot engine as base. I started making this build at the start of the Summer, and It's hard to say how much time I spend, some days its 6 hours, some its 3, and some I do nothing related to game engine. About art, its fully done by me, and I actually have a lot of models prepared before I started doing this build. I'm basically art guy, who can't get into programing (I tried for few years), so being able to get complicated code with AI, and just do part that are actually exiting for me, is awesome

Pretty much full core game loop is done, vehicle can connect equipment, plant and harvest, they have an internal storage and some basic UI in place. And system is modular and expandable, so adding new stuff is just a matter of importing a model and doing routine setup for it. Since camera is in isometric style, map is loaded in chunks, and it will load parts that are in camera view, or a small part under the vehicle (it's for future AI drivers). So it can be huge if I need, I tested one that was 2300x1250 and it was working fine (this one I'm not sure but I think is 750x500)

I even have a save file system already, closer to end when truck and harvester is freezing for a second, it's me activating saving, and then I move vehicle and force load that save, so vehicle gets teleported back

Currently I'm working on vehicle store menu, so I could buy vehicles dynamically

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
OP cultivating a pp. *I saw that*. 

I've enjoyed farming sim games before. Probably a little too much. This has defs taken that same aesthetic/flow into an isometric world. Interesting stuff! Looks really solid despite WIP assets etc I can see you've put lots into this :)

I've thought about this as a project myself, except on some alien planet, so I can make shit different and new. I think I've harvested all the pixelated wheat I can for one lifetime :')
